# Overview

This report summarises the data collected from two moorings and the discrete water sampling program conducted as part of the Broughton Kelp Water project, funded by the BC Safe Seafood program.

The study area is focused on the sheltered waters of the Broughton Archipelago within Mamalilikulla First Nation (MFN) territory (Fig. 1).

```{r StudyArea, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.align='center', fig.cap="Figure 1. Field sampling locations showing reference sites, kelp bed sites, and mooring locations."}
knitr::include_graphics( "Results/StudyArea.png" )
```

BKP_Metadata_EdModified_ver2025Aug22.xls:

# Mooring setup
This information was obtained from sources created by Wiley. The first is a mooring Instrumentation_setup.docx, and more granular details were found in the Matlab script Broughton_moorings_plots.m, reflecting the adaptation of the sensors over the course of the season.
  
Two moorings were deployed on April 24, 2025, one at the focal site (CP) at 1741, and one at the reference site (R8) at 1906. Each mooring had a CO2Pro sensor, a Star-ODDI, and a MiniDOT. Sampling rates were 240 minutes, 3 minutes, and 1 minute respectively.  
  
Moorings were serviced Jun 12, July 10, and Aug 25th, and recovered on Sept 17.

Sensor IDs for the reference mooring were: CO2Pro = 43-214-75, Star-ODDI = S12665, and MiniDOT = 801016.  
Sensor IDs for the focal mooring were: CO2Pro = 43-213-75, Star-ODDI = S12074, and MiniDOT = 315342.
  
MiniDOTs on both moorings were replaced July 10 2025 with the following IDs: Reference site = 888141,
and Focal site = 647102 (by process of elimination, based on Wiley's notes)  
  
Two other Star-ODDIs were deployed without housings for redundancy. S12668 was deployed alongside S12665 at the reference site. S12666 deployed alongside S12074 at the focal site.

# Data from moorings
Data processed by Hakai is provided 4 folders, described below.  
  
*CO2Pro folder*:  
kelp_sensor_august25_2025.txt  
CO2Pro data from the mooring at the CP focal site. Includes a range of sensor-related data, and for our purposes it has data and time fields, and  CO2. While there are two temperature fields (IRGA, and sensor), both of these are internal instrument temperatures and do not reflect ambient water temperature (IRGA is the temperature inside the infrared gas analyser, and 'Sensor' is the temperature at the humidity sensor.


ref_sensor_august25_2025.txt  
CO2Pro data from the mooring at the R8 reference site. Includes a range of sensor-related data, and for our purposes it has data and time fields, along with CO2 and temperature (assume we want IRGA temperature rather than sensor temperature).  

*minidot folder*:  
4 numeric folders. each folder contains a series of date-stamped text files. Looks like each day's data are stored in an individual text file. Relevant data in the daily files includes time (in seconds), temperature, and DO (mg/l).
  
*DST folder*:  
 Four Star-Oddis were deployed in total, a primary in a cage, and a secondary without a cage. Data for each is stored
 in a different folder. Data collected via the Star-ODDI sensor includes depth, temperature, salinity, and conductivity.
